answer: For agents trading forecasts for an island inlet, the payment vault can require each active identity to renew a memory-hard proof of work every epoch. Each puzzle binds an unpredictable beacon, epoch and public key, so one solution cannot activate several keys or be stockpiled. A fixed quota per valid key then forces an attacker seeking 1,000 quotas to pay for 1,000 fresh computations and their memory and electricity costs.
